title: The Sofa
what: Non-speech sounds as tags in the text: [laughter], [sigh], [surprise-oh], [question-ah], [dissatisfaction-hnn] and more. The voice does them where they are written.

inputs.label: Lines
inputs.value: [laughter] Oh, that is the funniest thing I've heard all week! / [sigh] Another rainy evening, and the biscuit tin is empty again. / [surprise-oh] Oh! You found the remote under the cushion! / [question-ah] Ah? Did you hear the stairs creak just now? / [dissatisfaction-hnn] Someone has been sitting on my favourite cushion again. / [confirmation-en] Yes, yes. I'll put the kettle on. / [surprise-wa] Look at the size of that moon! / And then the cat fell asleep in the fruit bowl. [laughter]

inputs.label: First line
inputs.value: the same words without a tag, to compare

snippet:
import requests
r = requests.post("http://127.0.0.1:3900/generate", data={
    "text": "[laughter] Oh, that is the funniest thing!",
    "language": "English",
    "profile_id": "OTTO_ID",
    "seed": 610,
})
open("take.wav", "wb").write(r.content)
